title: Integer order makes every subring ideal principal
statement: Let F be a field, let A be a subring of F with its inherited ring operations, and let ν : F → ℤ. Assume ν(f/g)=ν(f)-ν(g) whenever f and g are nonzero, and assume that for every nonzero f in F, f belongs to A if and only if ν(f) is nonnegative. Then every ideal of A is principal, so IsPrincipalIdealRing A holds.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type*) [Field F] (A : Subring F) (ν : F → ℤ), (∀ f g : F, f ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 → ν (f / g) = ν f - ν g) → (∀ f : F, f ≠ 0 → (f ∈ A ↔ 0 ≤ ν f)) → IsPrincipalIdealRing A
